policy: Five different strategies per OCG candidate year. Pre-2003 builds are period-pool adaptations: complete contemporary competitive deck records were not established, so no player placement or popularity is claimed. Historical extra-deck sizes are retained; all newly adapted Side Decks have 15 cards for the game’s Match mode.
